crew.overview: Set in the Bronx during the tumultuous 1960s, an adolescent boy is torn between his honest, working-class father and a violent yet charismatic crime boss. Complicating matters is the youngster's growing attraction - forbidden in his neighborhood - for a beautiful black girl.
crew.title: A Bronx Tale

details.biography: Tony is a Bronx-Born filmmaker who made his directorial debut with Kiss Me, Guido. The film was selected for the Sundance Film Festival and picked up for distribution by Paramount Pictures. Due to a tight production schedule while working on A Bronx Tale, Tony was asked by Robert Deniro to shoot the opening shot of the film.
details.name: Tony Vitale
